# datadog_feature_flag (Resource)

Manages a Datadog Feature Flags flag. Deleting this resource archives the flag because the API does not expose a physical delete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_feature_flag" "checkout" {
  key                 = "checkout-redesign"
  name                = "Checkout redesign"
  description         = "Enables the redesigned checkout flow"
  value_type          = "BOOLEAN"
  default_variant_key = "off"

  variants = [
    {
      key   = "off"
      name  = "Off"
      value = "false"
    },
    {
      key   = "on"
      name  = "On"
      value = "true"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Stable, organization-unique key referenced by SDKs. Archived flags retain their keys.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name shown in Datadog.
- `value_type` (String) Type of every variant value. Valid values are BOOLEAN, INTEGER, NUMERIC, STRING, and JSON. Valid values are `BOOLEAN`, `INTEGER`, `NUMERIC`, `STRING`, `JSON`.
- `variants` (Attributes Set) Variants the flag can return. Changes force replacement; use unarchive_on_create when retaining the same key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variants))

### Optional

- `default_variant_key` (String) Key of the variant returned when no allocation matches. The API does not return this as a flag-level field, so an explicitly configured value is preserved in state.
- `description` (String) Description shown in Datadog. Defaults to `""`.
- `json_schema` (String) JSON Schema used to validate variant values when value_type is JSON. JSON formatting differences are normalized.
- `require_approval` (Boolean) Whether flag changes require approval. Setting this requires the Approvals Override permission and changes force replacement because the update API does not support it.
- `unarchive_on_create` (Boolean) When creation collides with an archived flag of the same key, adopt and unarchive it, then reconcile its variants and mutable fields. The value type, approval setting, and any readable default variant must match. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) Time the flag was archived, or null when it is active.
- `created_at` (String) Time the flag was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the flag was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--variants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variants`

Required:

- `key` (String) Stable variant key, unique within this flag.
- `name` (String) Human-readable variant name.
- `value` (String) Variant value encoded as a string, such as true, 42, or a JSON literal.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_feature_flag.checkout "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
```
